evidence_quotes.O: I have dragged this lens through the rain forests of the Amazon, backpacked with it in Europe and hiked with it in New Zealand.
evidence_quotes.C: I checked the Canon website to ensure compatibility and read the reviews regarding image quality before purchasing.
evidence_quotes.E: I plan on using the webcam with Skype and the hardware is exactly what I needed.
evidence_quotes.A: However, by using the recommendation of another reviewer of stuffing a sock into the bottom of the bag, I was able to ensure a snug fit
evidence_quotes.N: I do however, have some gripes about the cover. The plastic cover can make entering data with the rocker pad tedious
